filter_experiment: B versus B+filter only on queries with explicit part restriction; base A/B/C are unfiltered
split_rule: 15 dev questions from part 1 and part 2; 5 test questions from part 3. Different articles/topics are held out where feasible. These are continuation files of one law, so cross-references and shared terminology remain a leakage risk.
selection_rule: then lexical config name for deterministic ties
test_policy: Test retrieval runs only after dev selection is saved and configuration is frozen. Gold review at Gate 2 is permitted; no retrieval results exist yet. Do not tune on test.
gold_policy: Human verifies answers/conditions and evidence before approval. Whitespace-normalized matching is a check, not an independent semantic judge. Accept documented alternative source/page locations.
manual_audit: Human labels coherence on 10 preselected source positions and metadata/grounding on the same 5 test questions for each config. No AI-generated audit labels.
